Mod.name: Hideout Prototype | 藏身处测试版
Mod.description: 0.9.0 | Open your inventory near spawn to access the categorized stash. Drag items and loose spells between native slots and storage. Unload flasks and powder pouches in Materials. Click to load one unit or hold for more. The workshop opens between the stash and secure case. Recipes spend and produce bulk materials.
